notes:
## Offsets follow the client, not the release

- theo's table is now fetched for the Roblox build that is actually running, not for the newest dump. A client that is one or two builds behind the rollout keeps working instead of failing with `FakeDataModel chain returned 0`.
- `/versions` is read only on a mismatch: the app checks whether theo publishes a table for your build, and says which case you are in.
- If both static pointer chains fail, the FakeDataModel module slot is recovered by scanning the module, then written back to offsets.ini. Measured 250 ms on a live client with both chains broken.
- New coverage canary: `offsets_applied_peak` records the highest field count theo has ever mapped. A table that maps fewer fields logs a warning and shows a red line on the Offsets card instead of silently keeping stale values.
- Offsets tab prints the client build: up to date / behind latest (using this build's table) / no table for this build.

## ESP range

- Max distance slider goes to 20000 studs (was 2000), with near / map / whole map presets.
- Fade no longer scales with the slider: raising the range adds fish at the edge instead of brightening everything near you.
- Scan ceiling raised from 128 to 512 roamers.
- Status chip reports the real reach: `FISH 56  far 268st  59 fps` - the farthest resolved fish, not the slider value.

## Diagnostics

- `dm_probe.exe`: prints client build, theo's latest, index membership, resolve time, DataModel chain and place id. `--index-check <version>` asks theo directly. `--break-all` proves the slot-recovery path.
- `overlay_probe.exe --missing`: counts bucket children and names any model with no geometry, so a streamed-out or renamed fish is visible instead of silently absent.
- Offsets errors name the cause: "the table is for a different client build" instead of "offsets stale?".
- Log strings are plain ASCII; typographic characters no longer turn into mojibake in the log file.
